title: Neural network estimates gestational age from blind ultrasound sweeps
summary: From 4695 pregnant volunteers in North Carolina and Zambia, blind ultrasound sweeps of the gravid abdomen were recorded alongside standard fetal biometry, and a neural network was trained to estimate gestational age. In the main test set the mean absolute error was 3.9 +/- 0.12 days for the model versus 4.7 +/- 0.15 days for biometry (difference -0.8 days, 95% CI -1.1 to -0.5). Performance appeared to extend to sweeps collected by untrained providers in Zambia with low-cost devices. The model was not tested in a clinical deployment.
